messages:
jess: kicking off the runtime swap to kernel v2.3.4-quantB now. staging passed unit + perf. one smoke node flaked on large-batch path earlier though, flagging it.

sam: saw the same in staging logs, OOM-ish on 80-token batch. suspected kv-cache eviction timing. only affected 1 out of 8 nodes.

priyanka: thanks — can we gate canary at 2% and validate latency p50/p95 for the next 15m? put release-notes draft up at https://wiki.redwood/release/RT-2.3.4

deploybot: preflight checks: ✅ images uploaded, ✅ checksum OK, ✅ health probes passing on 90% stagers. canary rollout prepared. suggested canary=2%, step=+2% every 10m, max=20%. command: `/deploy runtime --image runtime:v2.3.4-quantB --canary 2 --step 2m --monitor latency,errors`

lee: minor nit — the quant kernel blob changed the FP16 kernel ordering. need compat flag set on prod nodes to `--compat-order=legacy` for the first slice. ops will toggle after canary stabilizes.

sam: +1 on 2% canary. monitoring checklist: p50, p95, token/sec, error-rate, and kv-cache-miss-rate. set alerts at p95 +30% and errors +0.5% absolute.

jess: starting canary now. tagging priyanka for runbook. :eyes:

deploybot: rollout started at 1746409090. canary set to 2% (slice: us-west-2a). next step in 10m. monitor endpoints: /health/runtime and /metrics/prometheus

opsbot: smoke tailing: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n prod --since=5m | grep -i oom` returned empty. one pod restarted once, investigating crashloop restart reason `OOMKill` in stack trace.

priyanka: pause on step. hold canary, duplicating staging repro locally with same batch sizes. if we reproduce, we'll fallback to v2.3.3 and mark rolling pin.

sam: thanks — grabbing recent heap dumps from the restarted pod: `gsutil cp gs://redwood-prod-dumps/heap-1746409082 /tmp`

deploybot: canary paused by priyanka at 1746409198. current traffic remains at 2%. rollback window opens if p95 > baseline * 1.3 or errors > +0.5% for 5m.

lee: repro succeeded on smaller infra with a specific CUDA driver mismatch (470.x vs 495.x). suggestion: circuit the new kernel on nodes with 495.x only, leave older drivers pinned to v2.3.3.

jess: OK. action plan: (1) pin older-driver AZs to v2.3.3 via deploybot pin command, (2) limit rollout to driver-495 AZs only, (3) rerun canary at 2% in those AZs, (4) if green for 30m, continue stepups.

sam: can we do a quick staged pin? `deploybot pin --selector driver=470 --version v2.3.3 --ttl 12h` will protect them.

deploybot: pin accepted for selector driver=470 -> v2.3.3 for TTL=12h. pinned 3 AZs.

priyanka: once pinned, I'll clear the crash repro in staging and resume canary in the driver-495 pool. also updating release notes to include driver compatibility section.

jess: timeline: aiming to resume 1746409300, re-evaluate at 1746409950 (30m). if any threshold breaches, we roll back entire canary and open an incident.

lee: note for postmortem: include kernel ABI diff and a short mitigation checklist (pinning, driver check, hotpatch path).

deploybot: resume approved by priyanka at 1746409300. canary restart in driver-495 pools only.

sam: monitoring now — p50 steady, p95 +5% but below threshold, errors flat. kv-cache-miss-rate unchanged.

jess: nice. continue stepups per plan. priyanka - can you add the driver note to release notes and call out the recommended driver versions?

priyanka: done. release note snippet: "Runtime v2.3.4-quantB: improved matmul quant kernel; requires CUDA >=495.x for full stability. Nodes with older drivers will remain on v2.3.3 during staggered rollout."

jess: ok closing the thread — will unpin driver=470 after 12h. thanks everyone :shipit:
